title: Colored Glowstone
description: Recoloured glowstone dust so you never mistake it for a totem during CPvP.
body: “This pack recolours glowstone dust in red and black so you never confuse it with a totem during CPvP. It boosts visibility, prevents misclicks in fast crystal fights, and helps you stay consistent in high‑pressure PvP situations. ![What the pack looks like in-game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/183f545eb50998eab2b77be5550f07d6956accf3.png)!
